Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 18, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how AmidTech LLC collects and uses personal information from clients, prospects and website visitors.

1. Information we collect

  • Contact details you send us: name, company, e-mail, phone, message content.
  • Billing information: company name, address, tax identifiers, invoice and payment records.
  • Project data you entrust to us to build or maintain your software.
  • Basic technical data from our hosting provider (server logs, IP address) for security.

Card payments are processed by our third-party payment processor; we do not receive or store full card numbers.

2. How we use it

To answer requests, prepare quotes, perform contracts, invoice and collect payments, provide support, meet legal, tax and accounting obligations, and secure our services. We do not sell personal information and do not use it for third-party advertising.

3. Sharing

We share information only with service providers needed to run our business, with authorities when required by law, or with your consent. Our main providers are Vercel Inc. (website hosting), Stripe, Inc. (card payment processing), Anthropic, PBC (website assistant), and our e-mail, banking and accounting providers.

4. Website assistant and news bar

The chat assistant on our website answers questions about our services. Messages typed in the assistant are sent to our AI service provider (Anthropic, PBC) only to generate a reply; they are not used for advertising and are not stored by AmidTech beyond the conversation. Please do not share passwords, card numbers or identity documents in the chat. The news bar shows public headlines with links to the original publishers; we are not responsible for third-party content.

5. Cookies

Our website uses no advertising or tracking cookies.

6. International transfers

AmidTech operates from the United States and Niger, and our providers are located mainly in the United States. Information you send us may therefore be processed outside your country. We limit these transfers to what is needed for the purposes described above.

7. Retention

Billing and contract records are kept as long as required by tax and accounting law (generally 7 years). Quote requests that do not lead to a contract are deleted after 24 months. Other data is kept for the duration of the relationship, then deleted or returned on request.

8. Security

We use HTTPS encryption, access controls and reputable providers to protect your information. If a security incident affects your personal information, we inform you without undue delay.

9. Your rights

You may request access, correction or deletion of your personal information by writing to contact@amidtechgroup.com. We respond within 30 days.

If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we process your information to perform a contract or take steps at your request, to meet legal obligations, and for our legitimate interest in running and securing our business. You may also object to or restrict processing, request a copy of your data in a portable format, and lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

10. Children

Our services are intended for businesses. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

11. Changes

We may update this policy and will post the new version on this page.
